signature: Removal of ornament; essential structure and content; purposeful whitespace.
boundary_rule: If polished decoration adds nonessential sophistication, classify as Clean.

signature: Balanced grid; understated surfaces; refined controls; strong visual clarity.
boundary_rule: Do not confuse with Minimalism or Swiss because a design uses a grid.

signature: Modular typographic system; rigorous alignment; scale ratios; grid-driven rhythm.
boundary_rule: Editorial may also use grids, but prioritizes narrative sequencing; Swiss prioritizes the system.

signature: Narrative hierarchy; covers, indexes, and reading; publication-like composition.
boundary_rule: A blog is not Editorial simply because it publishes articles; editorial art direction must shape the interface.

signature: Precise typography; carefully curated imagery; measured pacing; subtle detail and exclusivity.
boundary_rule: Not synonymous with beige, expensive-looking websites, or Minimalism.

signature: High information density; precision; monospaced type where useful; visible boundaries, tables, and code.
boundary_rule: A SaaS landing page with occasional monospaced text can still be Clean.

signature: Exposed HTML structures and web conventions; raw hierarchy; little visual accommodation.
boundary_rule: Minimalism without rawness is not Brutalism.

signature: Thick outlines; solid offset shadows; flat colors; emphatic box-based components.
boundary_rule: Web Brutalism does not require decorative blocks or hard shadows.

signature: Intentional violation of grid, hierarchy, and compositional conventions; controlled dissonance.
boundary_rule: Maximalism does not automatically subvert conventions; Brutalism can be highly ordered.

signature: Layered cutouts; mixed photographic and typographic media; DIY editorial assembly.
boundary_rule: Grunge is defined by sustained material distress rather than layering alone.

signature: Disruptive typography; aggressive color; distortion; club-culture references.
boundary_rule: Synthwave uses nocturnal 1980s iconography rather than contemporary acid graphics.

signature: Torn surfaces, noise, eroded ink, rough typography, and visibly distressed materials.
boundary_rule: Digital Collage can be crisp; Grunge applies systematic visual erosion.

signature: Flat geometric forms; bold color; repeated patterns; playful interaction.
boundary_rule: Colorful circles alone do not qualify; geometry must shape hierarchy and components.

signature: Expressive cuteness; characters, friendly icons, and soft shapes; playful rhythm.
boundary_rule: Mascot-led design without a consistent kawaii grammar remains an illustration attribute.

signature: Soft or toy-like volumes; manipulable 3D objects; studio lighting and tactile qualities.
boundary_rule: Spatial 3D refers to a navigation mode; Tactile 3D refers to a material visual language.

signature: Character grid; prompts; cursors; monospaced type; console-like navigation.
boundary_rule: Utilitarian design with a code snippet is not necessarily Terminal.

signature: Windows, menus, dialogs, icons, and classic desktop shells.
boundary_rule: Webcore is based on personal web pages, not necessarily operating-system metaphors.

signature: Structural pixels in lettering, icons, and controls; conventions derived from games.
boundary_rule: Pixel art appearing only in a hero image is a visual resource, not the dominant aesthetic.

signature: Synthetic sheen; iridescence; techno CGI; futurist geometry circa 1997–2004.
boundary_rule: Metalheart favors explosive fractals; Vectorheart relies on hard-edged vector construction.

signature: Fractal depth; metallic explosions and abstractions; digital typography.
boundary_rule: Do not confuse dominant fractal compositions with generic futuristic chrome.

signature: Angular vector forms; industrial vocabulary; high-contrast typography; diagonals.
boundary_rule: Metalheart builds distorted abstract volume; Vectorheart emphasizes precise vector graphics.

signature: Techno-naturalist optimism; glossy transparency; sky, water, foliage, and light.
boundary_rule: Glassmorphism does not require the nature/technology imaginary; Web 2.0 can be glossy without Aero.

signature: Personalizable backgrounds; GIFs; hyperlinks; HTML modules; personal-web identity.
boundary_rule: Retro Desktop uses window metaphors; Webcore draws on the vernacular of web documents.

signature: Customizable social profiles; emo/scene layering; icons, sparkle effects, mixed type, and modules.
boundary_rule: Webcore is broader; Scene has its own social and visual codes.

signature: Nostalgia for digital consumer culture; retro leisure interfaces; pastel and corporate collage.
boundary_rule: Synthwave evokes nocturnal neon and retrofuturist driving; Vaporwave evokes consumer nostalgia.

signature: Nocturnal 1980s look; purple and pink neon; perspective-grid horizon; driving imagery.
boundary_rule: Cyberpunk builds a narrative urban dystopia; Vaporwave favors pastel consumer nostalgia.

signature: Dystopian high-tech city; signage, neon, overlays, and industrial texture.
boundary_rule: Sci-Fi HUD presents instruments and data; Cyberpunk constructs a narrative world.

signature: Speculative instrumentation; modular indicators; data grids; overlays.
boundary_rule: Cyberpunk does not necessarily have a distinctive instrumental control system.

signature: Liquid chrome; synthetic biomorphic forms; refraction; reflective futurism.
boundary_rule: Y2K imagines the future around the year 2000; Hyperchrome uses a contemporary material-futurist language.

signature: Dream logic, memory, and incongruent atmospheres; narrative or environmental navigation.
boundary_rule: Weirdcore creates semantic unease through displaced signals; Dreamcore follows oneiric logic.

signature: Media uncanny; ambiguous signs; low-fidelity images; disorienting scales.
boundary_rule: Glitch refers to technical corruption; Weirdcore creates conceptual uncanniness.

signature: Impossible objects; juxtaposition; shifts of scale and conceptual visual logic.
boundary_rule: Dreamcore evokes memory and sleep; Surreal Digital may be crisp, clean, and conceptual.

signature: Natural materials; earth tones; warm typography; soft, expressive pacing.
boundary_rule: Quiet Luxury emphasizes exclusivity; Warm Organic emphasizes natural tactility and closeness.

signature: Botanical illustration; structural plant ornament; filigree and poetic composition.
boundary_rule: A flower in the hero section is not enough; botanical motifs must govern frames, typography, and navigation.

signature: Controls inspired by physical objects; relief, texture, and light that communicate affordances.
boundary_rule: Tactile 3D can portray playful objects without a functional object metaphor.

signature: Translucent panels; layered depth; blur, refraction, and luminous edges.
boundary_rule: Frutiger Aero also requires a techno-naturalist optimistic worldview; glass is a cross-cutting material.

signature: Grounded, urban turn-of-the-millennium futurism; softened city photography, muted greens and grays, signage typography, and open space.
boundary_rule: Unlike Y2K, it favors calm, metropolitan organic imagery over chrome, outer space, and techno CGI.

signature: Encyclopedic photo collage; isolated objects, diagrams, classical serif type, and exploratory navigation inspired by 1990s edutainment.
boundary_rule: Unlike Vaporwave, it organizes discovery and learning rather than parody and nostalgia for digital consumption.

signature: 2000s pop culture; glamorous ornament, sparkle, conspicuous luxury graphics, stickers, and exuberant type applied to commerce and social sites.
boundary_rule: Distinguish it from futurist Y2K and Scene/MySpace: it has its own commercial glam imaginary.

signature: Flat 2D vector compositions with curves, flourishes, flowers, and bright graphics characteristic of the 2000s.
boundary_rule: Do not confuse with Frutiger Aero, which foregrounds photography, transparency, and 3D/glass materials.

signature: Aquatic retro Internet imagery: digital textures, turquoise, nautical 3D visuals, tropical collages, and Tumblr culture.
boundary_rule: Do not merge with Vaporwave merely because both are nostalgic; their origins and visual worlds differ.

signature: Optimistic eco-tech vision; green infrastructure; biomimetic illustration; digital systems depicting sustainable worlds.
boundary_rule: Green branding or plant photography is insufficient; the interface must articulate an ecofuturist world.

signature: Warm, handmade 1990s aesthetic: earth tones, hand-drawn lines, paper, imperfect textures, and natural motifs.
boundary_rule: More specific than Warm Organic, with a recognizable historical, pictorial, and textural grammar.

signature: Highly saturated, intentionally flat Japanese pop illustration; characters and dense geometric pop patterning.
boundary_rule: Not every kawaii image is Superflat; it requires expressive flatness across the visual system.

signature: Empty transitional spaces; disorienting framing; navigation that creates spatial tension without relying on monsters or glitch.
boundary_rule: Do not confuse with oneiric Dreamcore or digitally anomalous Weirdcore; empty spatiality is the main signifier.

signature: Toy codes, childhood kitsch, and visual systems built from primary shapes, stickers, and exuberant color.
boundary_rule: Do not label any app made for children as Kidcore; deliberately nostalgic childhood codes must dominate.

signature: An interface whose visual and narrative system is built around distinctive authored illustration, rather than a decorative hero image.
boundary_rule: Do not confuse with Kawaii merely because characters appear or with Geometric Pop because illustrations are flat.

signature: Symmetrical ornamental geometry, arches, stepped motifs, fine lines, and architectural rhythm.
boundary_rule: Not simply Quiet Luxury: decorative geometry also structures controls and layouts.

signature: Diagonals, asymmetric grids, photomontage, typographic blocks, and geometric tension.
boundary_rule: Unlike Swiss, it emphasizes propagandistic dynamism and expressive asymmetry.

signature: A single isolated hero object, flat colors, striking lettering, and reduced advertising composition.
boundary_rule: Neither generic Minimalism nor Swiss: it organizes the page like an object poster.

signature: Systematic optical patterns, geometric interference, moiré, vibration, and ambiguous depth.
boundary_rule: Do not mistake one isolated shader for an interface whose entire visual system is optical.

signature: Cartoonish postmodernism; rubbery forms, toy-like controls, distorted lettering, and visual humor.
boundary_rule: Not equivalent to Kidcore; its cartoonish postmodern grammar is more specific.

signature: Analog science fiction; CRT displays, physical panels, hardware instruments, and tangible signals.
boundary_rule: Not Retro Desktop (OS windows) or Sci-Fi HUD (holographic overlays).

signature: Gel-like buttons; specular highlights; rounded corners; gradients, shine, and polished icons.
boundary_rule: Not equivalent to Frutiger Aero; its focus is control grammar, not techno-optimistic nature imagery.

signature: Deliberate digital corruption shaping typography, imagery, navigation, animation, and rhythm.
boundary_rule: A primary aesthetic only when corruption dominates multiple screens, not when a hover effect glitches.

signature: Biotech interfaces featuring biomaterials, clinical signals, tissue, mutation, and organic instrumentation.
boundary_rule: Unlike Cyberpunk, it uses a laboratory and biotechnology grammar rather than urban neon.

signature: Primitive 1990s CGI; artificial 3D environments, surreal objects, and synthetic textures.
boundary_rule: Unlike Surreal Digital, it has a recognizable retro-CGI visual language.

signature: Whiplash curves; vegetal ornaments; organic typography; framing and curvilinear composition.
boundary_rule: Not generic Romantic Botanical: Art Nouveau ornament forms a distinct formal system.

signature: Soft raised or recessed relief within a single material; dual shadows; continuous surfaces and pressed controls.
boundary_rule: Unlike Glassmorphism, it does not depend on transparency; unlike Claymorphism, it avoids prominent positive volume.

signature: Inflated, volumetric components; exaggerated radii; friendly colors; clay-like shading and tactility.
boundary_rule: Unlike Neumorphism, it uses visibly raised volume and more emphatically rounded forms.
